_howto: Paste prompts Zig likes into 'examples'. Fields: look = look id from looks.json (or '*' for any), group = optional look group (e.g. 'Studio'), idea = optional word the idea must contain (e.g. 'twerk'), phrases = short pieces to borrow (one is added to the prompt per Remix), tags = hashtags to put first, prompt = the full liked prompt (reference only, not inserted). Adults 21+ only: phrases/tags with youth, family or non-consent words are dropped automatically.
